sections.title: 📋  OP SIGNUPS
sections.body:
> Officers post an op with `/op create`, everyone else presses a button on the card.
> 
> `/op join <id>` puts you on the roster without the button
> `/op leave <id>` drops you off it
> `/op roster <id>` shows who's coming
> `/op list` lists recent ops and their IDs

If the op has a real date and time set, you'll get pinged **10 minutes before it starts**.

sections.title: ⭐  PERFORMANCE RATINGS
sections.body:
> `/rate @member <1-5> [note]` rates someone after an op
> `/rating-history @member` shows their average score and recent feedback

Ratings are how we track who's ready for more responsibility. Leave a note. A score with no reason helps nobody.

sections.title: 🪪  YOUR PROFILE
sections.body:
> `/roblox <username>` links your Roblox account and sets your nickname to match
> `/continent` records your continent so op times can be planned around you
> `/profile` shows your full card: Roblox, continent, ops attended, rating, activity

sections.title: 📈  ACTIVITY
sections.body:
> `/activity @member` shows messages, ops attended and last seen
> `/inactive [days]` lists who's gone quiet (default 14 days)

The bot tracks activity on its own, so there are no check-ins or forms to fill in. Just show up and talk.
